title: BUG: unsigned underflow in OpenPGP response parser when resplen<2
description: wp11_openpgp_sign, wp11_openpgp_authenticate, wp11_openpgp_get_ard all call memcpy(out, resp, resplen-2u) after checking resplen < 2u. If resplen==1 the check passes (1 < 2 is true → returns error) -- actually this path IS correct. But resplen==0: 0 < 2u → error returned correctly. Re-verify: the check is 'if (resplen < 2u) return err', so resplen=0 and resplen=1 both correctly return error. Actual trigger: verify the exact check in the source file -- may be correct. Research bead.
